xp.announcement_published_desc: Only published announcements are shown, and only between their start and end.
xp.announcements_empty_text: Announce planned work, changes or news as a banner, on home screens or in the bell.
xp.announcements_subtitle: Messages for everyone or for some roles, system-wide or for one application, shown for a period you choose.
xp.audience_hint: Leave empty to show it to everyone.
xp.content_hint: Formatting, lists and links are kept; scripts, styles and embedded frames are removed when the page is saved.
xp.delete_announcement_text: It disappears for everyone. The audit log keeps a record.
xp.delete_home_text: People it was for get the next screen that applies to them, or the plain welcome.
xp.delete_page_text: The page and its menu entries are removed, and nobody can open it any more. The audit log keeps a record.
xp.dismissible_desc: Once dismissed, it stays hidden for that person.
xp.field_gone: A field that no longer exists
xp.for_whom_hint: A person's own screen comes first, then a role's, then a department's (including parent departments), then the one for everyone.
xp.form_host_hint: The page shows the form's records list. People also need permission to view the form.
xp.home_active_desc: Inactive screens are kept but nobody gets them.
xp.home_editor_subtitle: A landing page assembled from widgets. Each widget shows only what the person may open.
xp.home_empty_text: Without one, everyone sees a plain welcome. Create a screen for everyone, then others for roles, departments or people.
xp.home_subtitle: The landing page people see, per role, department or person, for the main home or for an application.
xp.key_hint: Used in packages and links; it cannot change later.
xp.label: Label
xp.link_external: This page opens another website in a new tab.
xp.link_internal: This page opens another place in the application.
xp.load_failed: Could not load. Please try again.
xp.maintenance_default: The system is down for maintenance. Please try again later.
xp.maintenance_on: Maintenance mode is on: only people who may switch it can work.
xp.name: Name
xp.no_widgets_text: Add widgets: work waiting, records, reports, shortcuts, links, announcements or content.
xp.page_access_hint: Grant who may open this page in Roles & Permissions, on:
xp.page_subtitle: A page placed in the menu, with its own permission.
xp.page_unavailable: This page is not available to you.
xp.pages_empty_text: Create a page for guidance, links or a dashboard, then add it to the menu.
xp.pages_subtitle: Pages hold content, links, or a dashboard, report or form, and are placed in the menu like any form. Each page has its own permission.
xp.placement_hint: A banner across the top of every page, on home screens with an announcements widget, or in the notification bell.
xp.priority_hint: When several screens apply at the same level, the highest priority wins.
xp.published_desc: Only published pages can be opened. A draft can be edited without anyone seeing it.
xp.reports_unavailable: Choosing a report or dashboard needs the "Manage reports and dashboards" permission.
xp.result_subtitle_hint: A field shown under each result, for people who may see it.
xp.search_empty_text: Once forms are built, choose here which of them can be found from the search box.
xp.search_enabled_desc: People find only records they may see, matched only on fields they may see.
xp.search_fields_hint: Text fields only; sensitive fields are never searched. A higher weight ranks matches in that field first.
xp.search_roles_hint: Leave empty for everyone who may view the form.
xp.search_subtitle: Choose which forms the search box finds, in which fields, and for whom.
xp.shown_until_hint: Leave empty to keep it until you unpublish it.
xp.system_maintenance_hint: Takes the whole system offline with your message. People who may switch maintenance mode keep working and see a banner.
xp.tell_users_text: Everyone who may open the application gets an announcement in their notifications that links to this page.
xp.theme_acknowledge: I have reviewed the warnings and want to save the theme as it is.
xp.theme_application_hint: Leave empty for a theme that can be the organization default.
xp.theme_artwork_after_save_text: Artwork can be added once the theme is saved.
xp.theme_artwork_hint: Logos, favicon, the sign-in background and email header and footer. Images are re-encoded when uploaded.
xp.theme_choice.density.label: Density
xp.theme_choice.font_arabic.label: Arabic font
xp.theme_choice.font_latin.label: Latin font
xp.theme_choice.radius.label: Corners
xp.theme_choice.shadow.label: Shadows
xp.theme_clear_default_text: No theme will be the default. Applications with a theme of their own keep it.
xp.theme_clear_default_title: Go back to the product theme?
xp.theme_colours_hint: Leave a colour empty to keep the product colour, shown greyed in the box.
xp.theme_contrast_all_ok: Every colour is readable in light and dark mode.
xp.theme_contrast_hint: Text must reach 4.5:1 against its background in both modes, or the theme cannot be saved. Weaker non-text contrasts are warnings you acknowledge.
xp.theme_css_hint: Applies to the page content only, never to the menu, banners or dialogs. Plain rules with colour, text, border, spacing and shadow properties; no imports, URLs or !important.
xp.theme_delete_text: Screens that use it go back to the organization default, or the product theme.
xp.theme_editor_subtitle: Colours for light and dark mode, shape and fonts, the sign-in page and artwork. Every colour is checked for readable contrast before saving.
xp.theme_import_failed: The theme could not be imported
xp.theme_import_unreadable: This file is not a theme export
xp.theme_key_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores; used in exports.
xp.theme_now_default: This theme is now the organization default
xp.theme_product_in_use: The product theme is in use. Make a theme the default to change the look everywhere.
xp.theme_reset_text: Colours, shape, density, shadow, fonts and custom CSS go back to the product values. Texts, links and artwork are kept.
xp.theme_signin_hint: Shown on the sign-in page when this is the organization default theme.
xp.theme_start_from_hint: Replaces the colours, shape and fonts below.
xp.theme_was_reset: Theme reset to the product colours
xp.themes_empty_text: Start from a preset, adjust the colours, and check them in light and dark mode before saving.
xp.themes_subtitle: The organization's default look, and the look of each application. Without a default theme, the product theme applies with the brand colour from Appearance & Branding.
xp.type_hint.changelog: What changed in the application's forms. Once published, Tell users puts a link to it in everyone's notifications.
xp.type_hint.knowledge: The application's internal knowledge page: how it is used, who to ask, what to know.
xp.url_hint: An address starting with https://, or a path in this application starting with /.
xp.where_hint: The main home, or an application's own home (opened from its section in the sidebar).
xp.widget_rule: Show only to people who match
xp.widget_rule_hint: Optional. A rule on the person, such as their roles or department.
xp.widget_unavailable: This is not available to you.
xp.widgets_hint: Drag a widget to reorder it, or use its arrows. On a phone, every widget takes the full width.
